prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout for Custom Pet Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a carousel layout and live animated mascot component to streamline character selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
1: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Validation Safeguard Hint: Add a clear validation hint on the upload_photos screen specifying photo quality guidelines before processing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload a clear front-facing image for best custom pet generation."}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Two Column Sign In Safeguard Layout: Redesign the sign_in screen into a two-column layout highlighting pet data protection and cloud sync.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Protect Your Pet Progress", "body": "Sign in with your main account so your pet stays saved across all your desktop sessions."}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Preparation Waiting Progress Component: Display an active progress indicator bar on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
4: [finish, redesign] Centered Desk Setup Desktop Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen to a centered layout detailing clear instructions on pet controls and desktop visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open quick controls."}}
5: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Story Intro Path Selection Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight layout featuring an engaging mascot component and clear intro copy.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion Journey", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [adoption, copy] Official Certificate Adoption Pledge Copy Update: Update headline and body on adoption_certificate to emphasize pet ownership commitment and smooth finalization.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your new desktop companion is officially yours and ready to move onto your screen."}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Notification Banner: Enable readiness notification triggers on the waiting screen to alert users when companion setup finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you the moment your pet is ready on your desktop."}}
8: [sign_in, hint] Multi Account Sync Prevention Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign_in screen urging users to sign in with their existing account to avoid account resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your existing account to ensure your pet and progress are safely linked."}}
9: [finish, hint] Quick Pet Visibility & Hide Control Hint: Include a visible hint on home_intro explaining shortcut keys and mouse actions for pet visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P or right-click your pet to toggle visibility anytime."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning pick_friend layout and adding mascot inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a photo quality validation hint on upload_photos is allowed inside onboarding.
Redesigning sign_in into a two-column layout focusing on data sync is valid.
Adding a progress bar component to the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning home_intro layout with clear control instructions is allowed.
Redesigning the story screen with a spotlight layout and intro copy keeps its primary job.
Updating adoption certificate headline and body text retains its official adoption presentation.
Enabling notification triggers on the waiting screen is an allowed onboarding enhancement.
Adding an account linkage hint on the sign_in screen complies with onboarding rules.
Adding visibility shortcut hints on home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
